Specification: This specification models initialization and update of three state variables using advanced TLA+ EXCEPT syntax. It focuses on nested updates to a function whose values are records, updates to a function indexed by strings, and an update to a record field containing a tuple. The spec does not model faults, fairness, liveness, or proofs; it is primarily a syntax-oriented state machine with an Init predicate and a single Next action demonstrating several EXCEPT forms.
